changes: Rename the Quran verse page to "Quran verse challenge" and move its route to /quran-verse-challenge, keeping /ayat as a redirect.
Replace the Markdown feedback body with one plain-text field per section and a per-kind hint, so the sender never writes Markdown.
Seed the feedback body with a per-kind Markdown template and a hint, keep typed text when the kind changes, and reject a template that was never filled.
Let feedback carry up to three screenshots: scaled in the browser, stored in the public `feedback` bucket, and embedded in the filed issue.
Add `/feedback`: the form files a GitHub issue from the server, so sending feedback needs no GitHub account; linked from the footer menu and `/about`.
Add `/about`, which shows the running version, the beta marker and the data source.
Add `/changelog`, rendering this file newest first.
Add `/notifications` for version notices and admin-authored announcements, with an unread dot in the footer menu.
Add `/admin/notifications` to publish and delete announcements.
Add the version and changelog bump script and its CI check.
